description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named TimesheetRow used within a Human Resources Management System. It models a row of timesheet data associated with a specific project and activity, including related dates and total hours. The class provides methods for managing and assigning timesheet items to dates, ensuring no duplicate assignments occur.

classes.name: TimesheetRow
classes.description: Data transfer object representing a row of timesheet data linked to a project and activity, managing dated timesheet items and total hours.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TimesheetRow with a project, activity, and a set of dates.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Returns the project associated with this timesheet row.

methods.name: getProjectActivity
methods.description: Returns the activity associated with this timesheet row.

methods.name: setDates
methods.description: Converts and stores the provided date array into formatted date strings as keys with null values.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total hours accumulated for this row.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increases the total hours by a specified amount.

methods.name: assignTimesheetItem
methods.description: Assigns a timesheet item to a date within the row, throws exception if already assigned.

methods.name: getTimesheetItems
methods.description: Returns all timesheet items assigned to the dates in this row.
